explanation: This asks for a lower bound better than exp(c(log N)^{1/12}). The site now records h(N) ≫ exp(c(log N)^{1/9}), from Hunter's observation combined with Bloom–Sisask's improvement of Kelley–Meka. That beats every exp(c(log N)^{1/12}) by more than any constant, so it satisfies this formulation, and the `research open` tag is outdated. (The companion known_lower variant also still states the older 1/12 exponent.)
